title: Cross-sectional price momentum
hypothesis: PROPOSED: medium-term cross-sectional price momentum improves net mean daily return and zero-RF Sharpe versus monthly equal-weight ownership of the same historical source-defined common-equity universe, with directionally consistent chronological held-out Development folds.
rationale: Gradual information incorporation and investor underreaction may sustain medium-term relative price trends. This is a testable economic rationale, not evidence of predictive power.
expected_effect: Positive median held-out-fold mean daily net excess versus equal-weight universe, positive pooled mean excess and separate pooled zero-RF Sharpe difference; compare explicit SPY independently.
falsification_conditions: Nonpositive net mean excess or Sharpe difference versus equal-weight universe in untouched out-of-sample evaluation fails the directional hypothesis.
Fewer than three of four positive Development fold mean excesses prevents candidate advancement.
A result carried by an isolated cell/regime or erased by predeclared costs/delay weakens robustness; report rather than retune.
Critical invalid data/execution means an uninterpretable trial, not economic falsification.
confounders: Sector, size, beta, liquidity and volatility exposures; no factor-adjusted alpha claim.
Source-defined population, vendor omissions/revisions and unknown exchange/OTC venues.
Historical human/model knowledge, four-cell selection bias and dependence across folds.
Simulated corporate actions, delisting proceeds, turnover and effective deployment.
asset_universe: Historically effective unique source-covered CS stable identities; positive completed nominal prices and maximum-365-calendar-day price prerequisites; no membership, cap, ADV, exchange or ownership filter.

dynamic_universe.definition: Reuse the passed EXP003 source rule: unique historical CS security ID at prior completed price and intended execution; exclude identity/alias ambiguity, unknown subtype, nonpositive or missing prices. Require the same completed maximum-365-day price prerequisites for both horizons and the equal-weight universe. Retain ended/delisted histories while historically eligible. No certified additional nominal floor exists; only positivity. No complete US exchange-market claim.

permitted_indicators: 180/365 elapsed-calendar-day split-safe price momentum; first completed session on/after the elapsed boundary through prior completed session.
Historical identity and completed-price eligibility, exact monthly schedule, validity and full-session-date execution guards only; no additional alpha signal.

data_sources.name: Historical security_segments effective CS stable identity spans
data_sources.availability_timestamp: Historical effective from_date/to_date joined at prior completed price and intended execution; never current canonical symbols or survivors. Passed scoped EXP003 identity contract reused.
data_sources.revision_policy: Freeze immutable source snapshots and hashes; ambiguous historical aliases are excluded. Source-defined coverage, not full exchange membership or immutable vendor vintages.

data_sources.name: Completed nominal source prices and effective corporate-action splits
data_sources.availability_timestamp: Prior completed sessions available by preceding-calendar-day 21:00 America/New_York under inherited scoped finalized-EOD source contract; only splits effective through compared completed bars and known at cutoff.
data_sources.revision_policy: Local split-safe ratios; no future split factors or dividend double counting. Persist frozen snapshots, generation code and data hashes; per-run numeric QA required before submission. Bounded inherited evidence, not universal vendor revision immunity.

forward_paper.start_state: Required after historical evaluation and separate owner approval: minimum six calendar months and six monthly rebalance opportunities; extend if event coverage insufficient. Not deployed.

costs.slippage_note: Base 0.10% per fill; cash dividends. Proposed local +10/+20-bps absolute traded-notional stresses on both sides, fixed-fill sensitivities rather than native slippage/capacity simulation.

execution.event_rationale: Audit exact decision inputs, membership, validity/session guards, fills and fees. Events extracted first only after separately authorized jobs.
execution.assumptions: Monthly first audited tradable session; preceding calendar day21:00 NY cutoff; intended09:30 next-session execution. Completed split-safe local momentum; rank descending with stable-ID ascending ties; equal weights; long only/no leverage. Same maximum-horizon eligible population across four cells and EW. Nominal95% deployment; inherited bounded effective93.5% before fees. For N<K deploy95*min(N,K)/K, cash remainder; N0 liquidate to cash only when execution certified, otherwise critical failure. No silent broadening. Bind immutable numeric/ordinal/validity/session/schedule streams and log actual rebalance evaluations; no rejected custom lag.

robustness_tests: Four clean expanding chronological folds evaluated 2017,2018,2019,2020; two initial training years; completed past warmup outside scored returns. No fitted alpha parameters or separate training jobs.
Complete four-cell surface and both one-axis neighbors of every cell; isolated positive optimum flagged fragile, never substituted.

Inherited paired noncircular 20-return-block bootstrap,10000 draws,seed2002001,95% percentile descriptive intervals for mean excess and separate Sharpe difference; no p-values or significance claim. Holm is reserved/inactive.
Additional local 10/20bps cost per side on six full-Development fill tapes; one additional session execution delay on selected strategy and both benchmarks.

Predeclared causal SPY regime labels from prior completed closes: bull if trailing252-session price return>=0, bear otherwise; high volatility if trailing63-return annualized sample SD>=20%, low otherwise. Missing warmup remains unclassified. Labels are descriptive, fixed and not selection inputs.
temporal_contamination_note: Outer Validation2021-2023 and Test2024 designated before any EXP004 performance. All2021+ observations forbidden in design/Development by stage bounds and research cutoff; Test separately sealed. Workflow-held-out historical, not genuinely unseen: prior experiments and human/model knowledge are disclosed. Owner-only Test approval and later forward paper remain separate gates.
